```
error: command 'clang' failed with exit status 1
ld: library not found for -lomp
``` 
ci-bot: Build #482 failed on macos-latest — logs available at https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/482

sara: I'll re-run the mac job after the fix; if it still flakes I'll open an infra ticket. Blocking ETA: 2 hours.
kevin: If you want me to pair, I'm free at 16:00 PT — can help with mac toolchain setup.

liam: Once merged I’ll trigger the sample app canary deployment.
kevin: 👍
